A blank Transformer field works, with a caveat.

If you leave the model’s Transformer field empty, E3 falls back to a secure unarchive that allows the attribute’s declared value class plus the Foundation property-list types. A value whose class is neither (and with no declared value class on the attribute) decodes to nil rather than being deserialized. A non-decodable or foreign blob always degrades to nil and logs; it never crashes. For a custom class, prefer a named transformer so the class is explicitly allowlisted.

On the first launch after migrating from E2, expect a forced detach with

(code 202). The first attach in E3 wipes the existing E2 event store and registers a fresh peer, but the cached cloud identity token is not carried across either. The first identity check after attach sees no stored token, treats it as an account change, and forces a detach.

If your Ensembles 2 app used neither wrapper, add them only once the whole fleet is on Ensembles 3. The Zip wrapper reads compressed and uncompressed files interchangeably, so introducing it later is safe.
